Hape prime

Hape prime

8192 HAPES, designed to unite the HAPE multiverse.

The Hape Fashion Index

A different outlook of the collection, where ranking shifts according to fashion and determines the yield of your tokens in the ecosystem.

Wearable loyalty badges for your HAPES that act as bonus multipliers in your ranking and yield of tokens within The HAPE Fashion Index.

![Hape.io relaunch](https://cdn.sanity.io/images/ivpmqllf/production/8e4b7ea21148c2d041ca1f847d028cda9307062b-470x276.png?w=250&blur=100)

The latest version of our award-winning website, designed by Dogstudio.

Off-chain designs from exclusive partnerships for holders to customize their HAPE pfps throughout the year.

Hape or not

Community-driven game where everyone can vote on their favourite Hapes based on their style, giving them a boost in their Fashion Index score.

![Diesel physical product claim](https://cdn.sanity.io/images/ivpmqllf/production/e67c37c9d595d83163576010c03e02f743f102ac-1920x1080.jpg?w=250&blur=100)

HAPE x Caduceus: Airdropped 1M tokens for our community. $CMP token powers our Drops marketplace and is a main currency in the sale of our digital wearables.
